label: PF Backlog 449
title: intent-trace: resolve sibling-component descriptors (workergrid/) + command/flag kinds
body:
Source: found during the Stage 3c/3b descriptor audits (pre-implementation review), 2026-10-07.

Defect: intent_trace_check.py resolves every descriptor path under product-forge/ (_ROOT) only. Descriptors
that point at the sibling component workergrid/ (which lives at the repo root, one level above product-forge/)
therefore ALWAYS report "path not found" - so items BI-PF-0410..0414 show false drift and the check cannot be
trusted to catch real drift (the advisory noise hides it).

Also unhandled descriptor kinds: `command:scripts/pf.py sync` (a path + args) and `flag:PF_AUTO_PUSH` (an
env flag, not a path) are treated as bare paths and always fail.

Fix: resolve descriptor paths against product-forge/ OR the repo root (sibling components); treat `command:`
as its first token (path + optional args); treat `flag:` as membership in config/env-flags.json flags.

Out of scope: flipping the gate to --strict (tracked separately); the two genuinely-deleted Stage-3a paths on
BI-PF-0410 (workergrid/service.py, workergrid/store.py) remain correctly "not found" (historical).

dashboard_impact: needs_dashboard=false - developer tooling for the backlog traceability gate; no product UI.

**Follow-ups found during implementation (NOT in this slice):** the same "descriptor-kind treated as a path" class still affects two older items: (a) `item:BI-PF-0383` on BI-PF-0398 - the `item:` kind (a backlog id reference) is still resolved as a path; (b) `store:data/pidl/decisions.jsonl` on BI-PF-0380 - a `store:` descriptor holding a path instead of a registry key. Remaining intent-trace drift after this fix is otherwise genuine historical removal (the Stage-2b in-PF worker layer, and the two Stage-3a-deleted files on BI-PF-0410).

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; precheck --full green (39 gates, 843 passed, 3 skipped); intent-trace now resolves workergrid/ descriptors (BI-PF-0411..0414 clean; 0410 keeps its 2 genuinely-deleted Stage-3a files); new resolver test in test_design_review_guard.py
